Path 2, agent runtimeGOALS §3.2

Agent substrate

A vocabulary more than a product: the layer under an agent.

WHAT IT IS

Solo.io's framing, taken to a keynote with Anthropic and Google: the layer that gives an agent identity, a sandbox, session and state management, and egress control.

WHAT SETS IT APART

It's a checklist plus emerging implementations, not an install. Its value is making us name where each of the four comes from.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt the checklist as our production-readiness bar; decide implementations piece by piece.

"Agent Substrate" and "The Harness Is the New Runtime" keynotes, KubeCon NA 2026

DECIDE

Agent substrate: A vocabulary more than a product: the layer under an agent. Where we stand: Adopt the checklist as our production-readiness bar; decide implementations piece by piece. If we can't fill in all four boxes for an agent, it doesn't go to production.
